No rocket body, no smoke, no steam, no flames, no soft or transparent effects. Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background, no ground scenery beyond the base plate, no shadows on the background. provenance.notes: Generated illustration of an invented satellite launch site; no real photograph, artwork, logo, lettering, emblem or livery was used. As the issue asks, it shows a gantry with a small satellite and no rocket body. The bronze-brown gantry with a satellite keeps it apart from the Rocket Program's rocket and steel gantry. The source image reached the project through a chat paste (a re-encode, not the owner's original file), so the recorded hash is of that pasted copy. Checked at full size: no lettering. Generator provenance metadata (for example C2PA) is dropped by the re-encode. Non-commercial hobby game; re-check the terms before any commercial release (docs/asset-rights-ledger.md).
